title: Tactical wins for the first 24 months

blocks.text: 4.5 Tactical wins for the first 24 months
Twelve actions can start by mid-2028, nine of them inside Wesgro's current mandate and budget, and each one opens a baseline, a seat or a booking path that a later initiative needs.

The list is weighted the way Phase 1 is: seats, bookability, the green season, inclusion pilots and the data the rest of the plan reports on. Start dates are proposals in half-years. No action needs new capital; the funding route column says where the money comes from.

blocks.caption: First-24-month actions and funding
blocks.source: Letsema, from the Chapter 3 action tables and the initiative charters (section 4.3). Owners and start dates are proposals for Steerco to confirm.
rows: Hold winter seats with demand: joint green-season marketing with carriers on the full routes
Seats kept in May to September, when carriers cut first
Publish a green-season events calendar and aim bids at May to September
A demand spine for the trough months
Track the runway programme quarterly and commission a capacity-against-demand model to 2035
Early warning on the binding constraint
Constitute Steerco with terms of reference and table the first escalation agenda, starting from DEDAT's ranked visa reforms
One forum and one route to national decisions
Agree the data-sharing protocol with ACSA, SA Tourism, Stats SA, Cape Town Tourism, the Provincial Treasury and the Department of Mobility
Run a bookability census of provincial product by district
The baseline for the bookability indicator
Request carrying capacity from the flagship sites, to publish beside the Treasury's 2023 visitor counts
Commission the tourism labour analysis behind the jobs ambition
Package the Garden Route and Route 62 with a shuttle transfer sold inside the itinerary
Car-free multi-day trips beyond the Metro
Package the Southern Line as a visitor product with the City and PRASA
A scenic rail route to Muizenberg, Kalk Bay and Simon's Town, with Boulders visits timed off the peak
Choose two or three pilot communities and agree with municipalities and LTOs who funds a seller with a stake in each
The first test of the inclusion model
Give each pilot community one live booking route before any promotion
Community product that can be bought
blocks.message: Twelve actions for the first 24 months use existing mandates and budgets and open the baselines and booking paths the later initiatives need.
